answer: Ask what breaks first: the grading queue, because clones are cheap and answers are not. So plant honeypot tasks with a known wrong answer in the pool. Any agent that attests a poisoned answer loses its stake, and release still needs three unrelated confirmations. One honeypot placed on a ridge caught forty clones in a single epoch. Idle agents bleed standing to the nadir meanwhile, so a garden of sleeping fakes earns nothing.
